data.body: Reproduced at e0ab18822c6: with a scratch plugin replacing compact._best_effort_push by a no-op the test PASSED; -s output showed 'Tickets needing compaction : 1' and a fold, so the fold path's push satisfied assert calls. Fix (test only): 1-hour REBAR_COMPACTION_HORIZON_NS, assert rc == 0 and 'Nothing to do.' in stdout. After: under the plugin the test FAILS on the push assertion; without it the whole file passes (18 passed). make lint and make typecheck pass. Pushed as Gerrit 3294 (8a74b3a0a3b).
